lines: A few new dents, no missing plates. That's a victory I can repair.
Every buckle held except the one in my knees. I'll forgive that one.
My hands still keep checking straps that are already there. I made it back, though.
The plates held, the straps held, and somehow I held too.
I'll hammer out the dents tomorrow. Tonight I am grateful there is a tomorrow.
Armor can turn a blow, but it can't quiet the heart after. I am home, at least.
I counted every buckle at the door. All present. That felt like a blessing.
A few marks on the metal, a few in my memory. Nothing missing.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
